scene: The friendly seal barks happily and nudges an old brass key toward you.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the rocky reef. Far left sits an encrusted wooden crate. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest kneels, patting the smiling seal. Centre, a shiny brass key rests on the rock. Far right stands the striped lighthouse with a rusty ladder bolted beside its red door.
shown: a shiny brass key lying on the flat stone in centre
a rusty iron ladder bolted to the lighthouse wall on far right
a barnacle-encrusted wooden cargo crate sitting closed on far left
